methodology.trackedScope: git ls-files -z, all tracked regular files; binary files retained without line metrics
methodology.physicalLines: newline-delimited physical lines, includes blank lines/comments, ending newline not counted as extra line
methodology.typescript: TypeScript compiler createSourceFile AST; real function declaration/arrow/method spans. Branch counts include nested functions and are structural indicators, not cyclomatic complexity.
methodology.java: Comment/string/text-block masked brace-balanced regex method recognition; approximate, not Java grammar validation. Does not claim every constructor/lambda/record captured.
methodology.hookCounts: TypeScript AST identifier call count including generic calls; no alias/symbol resolution
methodology.imports: static ES imports/exports with relative or @ alias resolution, dynamic imports/requires not included in graph; typeOnly is retained separately and SCC totals below include type imports unless explicitly runtime.
methodology.reviewMeaning: All-file structural enumeration only; not semantic review pass
